reason: Primary purpose is plugin lifecycle and runtime management for DeepSeek Harness: users can install, enable/disable, and uninstall plugins without hand-editing config through web settings, CLI, or chat command; evidence shows it rewrites managed sections of `cordis.patch.yml`, supports package installation via pnpm, and exposes `/plugin-manager/api`, so it is best classified as a plugin-management utility in the plugin-development category.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可视化与命令方式的插件管理入口，可在界面、命令行或聊天命令下安装、启用/禁用和卸载插件并更新配置。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a plugin-management interface for DeepSeek Harness, allowing users to list, install, enable/disable, and remove plugins through the web UI, CLI, or `/plugin` chat command while updating profile configuration.

capabilities: Installs and removes plugins via pnpm commands
Exposes plugin-management HTTP endpoints in the host runtime
Provides CLI commands and chat-command handlers for plugin actions
Toggles plugin loader entries (enable/disable) in live or restart-backed flow

reasons.code: README states the plugin installs, enables/disables, and uninstalls DeepSeek Harness plugins from web UI, CLI, and /plugin chat command.
README describes automatic writing of `cordis.patch.yml` and managed block handling, indicating local file mutation as a core capability.
Package manifest defines a CLI binary (`dsh-plugin-manager`) and client bundle exports, indicating both terminal and web-facing integration.
